observations.summary: Provider homepage directs Ohio electrical permit and plan-review applications in its jurisdictions to ezTrak from September 14, 2026. This statement does not enumerate township/address coverage.

Provider form remains accessible with Ohio/Kentucky choices, signs/neon and billboard categories, building-permit reference, job/owner/applicant details and sign electrical quantities. Homepage Ohio migration guidance conflicts with treating this form as the current Ohio submission route.

Provider page dated effective February 2019 lists one combined PDF, affected-system diagrams, schedules/load summaries and equipment identification. It retains front-counter wording while linking ezTrak. Confirm current sign-specific scope and acceptance; printed code references are not approved current editions.
